name: Sparse-Controlled 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method using a small set of control points with influence weights to drive the deformation of other Gaussians, resulting in a compact and editable representation.
summary: Sparse-Controlled 3D Gaussian Splatting is a dynamic scene representation that enables user-driven editing by propagating sparse control point edits via a compact influence model, offering greater editability and memory efficiency than per-Gaussian MLP methods.
